issues.legal_issue: Expenses for the organisation and support of modern agricultural farming are deductible when incurred for crop production, preparation for market, or transportation of produce.
material_facts: The assessee conducted farming on a large scale and employed managers and other staff to supervise and support its farms.

The claimed expenses included staff and management costs, accommodation and repairs, medical facilities, provident fund contributions, vehicle and travel costs, and office and technical-information expenses.
The tax authorities disallowed the expenses without determining whether each item was incurred for farming operations or whether part of an expense could be apportioned to those operations.
issues.conclusion: The expenses may be allowed, wholly or in part, to the extent it is determined that they were incurred for managing, supervising, organising, or providing technical knowledge, assistance, or other allied support for raising crops, preparing them for market, or transporting them. Each item must be assessed on that basis, with apportionment where necessary.
issues.legal_principle: Section 6(2)(b)(iv) of the United Provinces Agricultural Income-tax Act, 1948, permits deduction of expenses incurred in raising a crop, making it fit for market, and transporting it to market. The provision must be applied broadly in light of the organisation and technical support required for modern large-scale farming; raising crops is not limited to ploughing, sowing, and harvesting. The Court generally agreed with the Allahabad High Court's decision in Agricultural Income-tax Reference No. 366 of 1953, and distinguished Mrs. Bacha F. Guzder v. Commissioner of Income-tax, Bombay, 27 I.T.R. 1, and Commissioner of Income-tax, West Bengal v. Raja Benoy Kumar Sahas Roy, 32 I.T.R. 466, as addressing different questions.

predicates.agricultural_income_expense_deduction_cl: The proceeding concerns a claim to deduct expenses in computing agricultural income.
predicates.expense_incurred_for_crop_operations: The expense was incurred for managing, supervising, organising, or supporting the raising of crops, preparing them for market, or transporting produce.

issues.definition: When an agricultural-income deduction claim concerns an expense used for crop operations, the expense is deductible only to the extent of that use.
